items.title: Oscar Peterson interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: I knew his brother was a drummer, Lee.

ctx.x: Yeah. Lester tells a story about —
I knew his brother was a drummer, Lee.

He tells a story about he played drums, he says that, “By the time I got through packing up all them drums all the other ladies was gone — with all the ladies — there was no ladies left at all. The other ladies had gone then, so I got me something I could throw it in a suitcase and move real quickly.”
